characteristics.name: Born With Quick Feet
characteristics.effect: AGI and COD cost 15% less.

characteristics.name: Naturally Fast
characteristics.effect: SPD and ACC cost 12% less.

characteristics.name: Explosive First Step
characteristics.effect: ACC costs 18% less.

characteristics.name: Natural Athlete
characteristics.effect: AGI, COD, JMP and ACC each cost 8% less.

characteristics.name: Natural Hands
characteristics.effect: CTH costs 15% less and CIT 8% less.

characteristics.name: Body Control
characteristics.effect: JMP costs 15% less and SPC 10% less.

characteristics.name: Route Savant
characteristics.effect: SRR and MRR cost 12% less; DRR 8% less.

characteristics.name: Sudden Release
characteristics.effect: RLS costs 18% less.

characteristics.name: Vertical Tracker
characteristics.effect: DRR and SPC cost 10% less; JMP 8% less.

characteristics.name: Possession Specialist
characteristics.effect: CIT costs 15% less; CTH and SRR 6% less.

characteristics.name: YAC Natural
characteristics.effect: COD, BTK and BCV cost 10% less.

characteristics.name: Contested-Catch Monster
characteristics.effect: CIT and SPC cost 15% less.

characteristics.name: Slot Technician
characteristics.effect: SRR and COD cost 10% less.

characteristics.name: Deep Threat DNA
characteristics.effect: SPD 8%, DRR 12%, RLS 6% cheaper.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Cascades strongly with Naturally Fast, therefore premium.

characteristics.name: Red-Zone Weapon
characteristics.effect: JMP and SPC cost 8% less. TD-based weekly challenges pay +1 bonus XP, max +1/week.

characteristics.name: Versatile Weapon
characteristics.effect: Secondary-role attributes cost 10% less: WR ball-carrier ratings; TE crossover receiving/blocking ratings.

characteristics.name: Blocking Pride
characteristics.effect: TE only: RBK/PBK/impact-blocking ratings cost 12% less. WR receives 10% cheaper blocking ratings if exposed by Madden.

characteristics.name: Third-Down Target
characteristics.effect: Reception/first-down style weekly challenges pay +1 XP when completed, max +1/week.

characteristics.name: Faster Developer
characteristics.effect: Earn +15% Player XP from all eligible sources. Dev-trait promotion challenge checks occur 50% more often until the player reaches X-Factor. Does not guarantee promotion; the challenge still must be completed.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Directly accelerates both ratings growth and access to development promotions, so it consumes half the build.

characteristics.name: Team Player
characteristics.effect: Team XP functionality is unlocked from Season 1. The player may convert his earned Player XP to Team XP at the normal 4:3 rate even before reaching his personal ceiling. XP already spent on teammates cannot be reclaimed.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Creates roster-wide value years earlier than normal.

characteristics.name: Great Negotiator
characteristics.effect: All REC Coin contract offers are increased by 20% after the normal contract-value calculation. Applies to Contracts II and III; Rookie Contract remains draft-slot based unless league configuration enables rookie negotiation bonuses.

characteristics.name: Known Commodity
characteristics.effect: For Contracts II and III, the player's performance component can never produce an offer below the 'Elite' salary band. The contract engine values him as an established ceiling-level asset even after a poor contract window.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Removes most downside risk from the career economy.

characteristics.name: Competitive Drive
characteristics.effect: Completing all three issued weekly challenges grants +2 bonus Player XP, once per league week.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Requires performance rather than granting passive ratings.

characteristics.name: Film Junkie
characteristics.effect: Future AWR upgrades cost 20% less Player XP. Defensive players also receive 20% cheaper PRC upgrades. Does not change IQ-test results.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Permanent discount on highly valuable mental attributes.

characteristics.name: Generational Ceiling
characteristics.effect: Starting development trait is Star rather than Normal. The player is eligible for future Superstar/X-Factor promotion challenges through performance. No direct ratings are added.

characteristics.name: Personnel Chief
characteristics.effect: Unlocks the Trade Center for this franchise after the perk is purchased from the Progression Tree.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Opens player movement that is otherwise locked in Rise to Immortality; Progression Tree Tier 2.

characteristics.name: Development Staff
characteristics.effect: Unlocks Player-XP purchases that promote a teammate's development trait. The commissioner still replicates the trait in Madden.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Lets the created player invest in the roster around him; Progression Tree Tier 3, requires any Tier 2 perk first.

characteristics.name: Route Technician
characteristics.effect: REL, SRR, MRR and DRR each cost 8% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Full route tree identity; Progression Tree Tier 2.

characteristics.name: Contested Catcher
characteristics.effect: CTH, CIT and SPC each cost 8% less Player XP.

characteristics.name: YAC Artist
characteristics.effect: BCV, JKM and SFA each cost 8% less Player XP.

characteristics.name: Spotlight
characteristics.effect: Earn +10% Player XP from all eligible sources.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Permanent earn-rate bump on top of Origins perks; Progression Tree Tier 3.

characteristics.name: Separation Artist
characteristics.effect: REL and SPD cost 12% less Player XP.

characteristics.name: Alpha Target
characteristics.effect: CTH, CIT, SPC and REL each cost 8% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Number-one receiver suite; Progression Tree Tier 4, requires a Tier 3 perk first.
